q: A clerk is formally ordered to hold full additional charge of another post for 30 days. He claims Additional Post Allowance for the month. What is the correct position?

options.A: APA is payable at 10% of his basic pay for the 30 days
options.B: No APA is payable, because the additional charge did not exceed 45 days
options.C: APA is payable at 5% of his basic pay for a spell below 45 days
options.D: APA is payable in full because a formal order was issued

q: An employee holds full additional charge of another post for 52 days. No separate pay attaches to the additional post. Which statement about his APA is correct?

options.A: APA is admissible at 2% of his own basic pay per month
options.B: Only the pay of his own post is payable, as in current charge
options.C: APA is admissible at 10% of his own basic pay per month
options.D: APA is not admissible because the spell is below two months

q: For 70 days an employee is asked to hold only current charge of a higher post, looking after its day-to-day routine work without discharging its statutory functions. He claims APA. The claim is:

options.A: Admissible at 10% of his basic pay, as the spell exceeded 45 days
options.B: Admissible at 10% of the higher post's pay
options.C: Not admissible; he draws only the pay of his own post
options.D: Admissible for the period beyond 45 days only

A loco pilot and a clerk draw the same basic pay. The loco pilot's DA for the month is visibly higher. The reason is that for running staff DA is calculated on:

options.A: Basic pay plus the 30% pay element of running staff
options.C: Basic pay plus the running allowance actually earned
options.D: Basic pay doubled for the running portion of duty

q: An employee's full additional charge of another post lasts exactly 45 days and then ends. His APA claim should be:

options.A: Allowed, because 45 days is the qualifying minimum
options.B: Rejected, because APA requires the additional charge to exceed 45 days
options.C: Allowed at half the monthly rate for the 45th day
options.D: Allowed, because the charge was of a full post

q: A teacher is given charge of the school library as a specified extra duty in addition to his normal work, and claims Additional Post Allowance. The correct treatment is:

options.A: APA at 10% of basic pay is payable for the library charge
options.B: No allowance of any kind can be paid for extra duties
options.C: Additional Allowance for running staff is payable instead
options.D: The claim is not APA; specified extra duties are covered by Extra Work Allowance at 2% of basic pay

q: Which of the following statements about current charge is NOT correct?

options.A: An employee holding current charge of a higher post draws APA at 10% of his basic pay
options.B: Current charge means looking after only the day-to-day routine duties of a post
options.C: An employee on current charge does not discharge the statutory functions of that post
options.D: APA requires full additional charge, not mere current charge

options.C: Additional Post Allowance is the running staff allowance paid at Rs 750, Rs 1,125 or Rs 2,250 per month
options.D: Additional Post Allowance compensates full additional charge of another post

options.A: Both A and R are true and R correctly explains A
options.B: Both A and R are true but R does not explain A
options.C: A is true but R is false
